name: Rajnish Retail Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1995, Sheetal Diamonds Ltd manufactures, trades and exports loose diamonds and jewelry
keyPoints:
Product Portfolio[1]
A) Diamonds: Company uses finest cut Belgium diamonds available in 9K, 10K, 14K and 18K gold, platinum and silver. 
a) White Loose Diamonds[2]
b) GIA, IGI, HRD Certified Diamonds[3]
c) Fancy Cut Diamonds[4]
d) Fancy Color Diamonds[5]
B) Jewelry:
Company has over 1,00,000 jewelry designs comprised of:
a) Ring[6]
b) Earring[7]
c) Pendant[8]
d) Bracelet/Bangle[9]
e) Necklace[10]
f) Nose Pin[11]
In addition to above, company offers finish inclusive of Rhodium Plating, Guaranteed 
Silver Plating, Antique Silver Plating, Gold 
Plating, Antique Gold Plating, Lacquer Gold Plating, Rose Gold Plating, Carat Gold Plating, Victoria Plating, Two-tone plating in gold and rhodium.

pros: Company is expected to give good quarter
Debtor days have improved from 235 to 101 days.
cons: Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
Company has a low return on equity of 1.25% over last 3 years.
